title: A line with labor by a deleted staff member still reads Deleted user
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Schedule access: the Admin role has Schedule > View and Create & Edit (Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • A work order [WO-1] at this location has a line whose labor was logged by a staff member who has since been deleted, so its Labor row reads "Deleted user".
  • One technician [Tech-J] in the Service department (example "Jenny Wilson").

Setup

  1. Find such a line: open work orders you know were worked by former staff and check their Lines tab. If there is none on this site, mark the case Blocked with "no Deleted user line on this site".
  2. Click Schedule in the top menu > click the > arrow next to Today once so the date reads tomorrow. In Search work orders (left) type [WO-1]. Drag its card onto [Tech-J]'s row (scroll the rows down to find it) and drop it under 10 AM. In the window that opens click Choose lines, tick only "that line", use − / + until Hours reads 2h and click the Create button (it reads "Create 1 shift" or "Create shift · 1 line · …").
  3. Check the setup worked: tomorrow [Tech-J]'s row shows the shift on that line.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1] and click the Lines tab.
  2. Read that line's Labor row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Labor row still reads "Deleted user". The scheduled technician does not replace a line that has real labor.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §8; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted (S7-R8). Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • QA handoff §8: “A line with real labor keeps its labor technician, and "Deleted user" stays.”
  • PRD S7-R8: “On the work order’s Lines tab, a line with no labor technician but with technicians scheduled on it from the Schedule shows those technicians’ names in its Labor row, in place of “Unassigned”.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
